rows.note: Use 改 as the all-purpose spoken verb when changing part of something.

example.english: I want to modify these trousers to make them shorter first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 dyun2 tiu4 fu3 sin1

rows.note: Use 限制 when modifying something means setting bounds on it or keeping it within limits.

example.english: We need to modify the event by limiting the number of participants to fifty.
example.traditional: 個活動要限制參加人數，最多五十個。
example.jyutping: go3 wut6 dung6 jiu3 haan6 zai3 caam1 gaa1 jan4 sou3 zeoi3 do1 ng5 sap6 go3
